record.oneLiner: DataForSEO provides SEO and search data (SERP, keywords, backlinks, domain analytics, labs) through REST APIs.
record.verdictReason: A developer creates a free account and gets an API login and password from the API Access tab, with a free Sandbox and a $1 trial credit for limited real calls; production use is paid by balance. DataForSEO publishes an official MCP server (dataforseo org on GitHub) that is hosted and also runs locally.

evidence.quote: Basic authentication is the only way to access DataForSEO API; credentials should always be passed in the header of the request.
Create a free account with DataForSEO, then go to the API Access tab
DataForSEO API is using the REST technology for interchanging data between your application and our service.
MCP server and CLI for LLM agents to browse DataForSEO API documentation and make authenticated API requests.
